resolved.title: 初识SWITCH
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Switch[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

But what if you need to test for multiple conditions? In those cases, writing [b]if else[/b] statements for each condition might not be the best solution. 

Instead, we can use the [b]switch [/b]statement to perform different actions based on different conditions.

Here's what that looks like:[code format="js" ][b]switch[/b] (expression) {
 [b] case [/b]n1: 
     statements
     [b]break[/b];
 [b] case[/b] n2: 
     statements
     [b]break[/b];
  [b]default[/b]: 
     statements
}[/code]
The switch expression is evaluated once. The value of the expression is compared with the values of each [b]case[/b], and if there’s a match, that block of code is executed.
[note][b]Heads up![/b]
You can achieve the same result with multiple if...else statements, but the switch statement is more effective in such situations.
[/note]

resolved.title: Break关键字
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The break Keyword[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

So we have learned that the switch statement tests a code block, but we won't always want it to test the whole block. The [b]break [/b]keyword essentially switches the switch statement off.

Breaking out of the switch block stops the execution of more code and case testing inside the block.
[note][b]Heads up![/b]
Usually, a [b]break [/b]should be put in each case statement.[/note]

content.text: 你可能已经注意到了前面的switch语句中每个case语句的最后一行都有一个`break;`，一般我们在执行switch/case语句的时候，我们并不希望switch每个条件都被判断和执行，因此需要引入`break`关键字，它的作用就是跳出`switch`语句。
content.text_html:
So we have learned that the switch statement tests a code block, but we won't always want it to test the whole block. The **break **keyword essentially switches the switch statement off.

Breaking out of the switch block stops the execution of more code and case testing inside the block.

所以我们已经知道switch语句测试一个代码块，但我们并不总是希望它测试整个代码块。突破**键词基本上可以关闭switch语句。

从switch块中分离出来后，就会停止执行更多的代码和块内的案例测试。

content.text: 通常情况下，应该在每个case语句中放一个`break`语句。
content.text_html:
Heads up! Usually, a **break **should be put in each case statement.

头条新闻！ 通常情况下，应该在每个case语句中放一个**break **。

content.name: 暗黑主题
content.description: 根据输入的数值来判断输出当前的主题颜色是什么？
content.title: 颜色编码

resolved.title: 颜色编码
resolved.problem_statement_md:
用户可以选择浏览器的颜色主题，每个颜色主体均有对应的数字编码，如下：
```text
1 -> 浅色
2 -> 深色
3 -> 夜曲
4 -> 终端
5 -> 靛蓝
```

给定一个程序，输入数字，根据输入的数字向控制台输出对应的主题。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Switch statements[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The user can choose the color theme for the browser:
1. Light
2. Dark
3. Nocturne
4. Terminal
5. Indigo

You are given a program that takes
 the number as input. Complete the program so that it will output to the console the theme according to input number.

[b]Sample Input
[/b]2

[b]Sample Output[/b]
Dark

[note]Don't forget to use [b]break[/b] for each case statement.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: - 不要忘记在每个case语句中使用**break**。

code_templates.solution_code:
function main() {
    var themeNumber = parseInt(readLine(), 10)
    switch (themeNumber ){
        case 1:
        console.log("浅色")
        break
        case 2:
        console.log("深色")
        break
        case 3:
        console.log("夜曲")
        break
        case 4:
        console.log("终端")
        break
        case 5:
        console.log("靛蓝")
        break
    }
}

resolved.title: Default关键字

content.text:
通常情况下，我们不一定需要完全处理switch语句中的所有可能，也就是若没有`case`能够匹配条件时，我们需要处理一些事情。

这个时候`default`关键字就会派上用场，它的作用是没有`case`能够匹配时，`default`后的代码块将会被执行。

如下所示：
content.text_html:
Often there will be no match, but we still need the program to output something...for this we use the **default **keyword, which specifies the code to run if there’s no case match.

Like this:

通常情况下，没有匹配，但我们仍然需要程序输出一些东西......为此，我们使用默认的关键字，它指定了在没有案例匹配时要运行的代码。

像这样：

content.text:
上面的代码中，所有的`case`都匹配不到`yellow`，所以会执行`default`代码块中的代码，输出：

```text
Color not found
```
如果不需要处理没有找到匹配的情况，可以省略`default`代码块。
content.text_html:
Heads up! The default block can be omitted, if there is no need to handle the case when no match is found.

抬头！ 如果不需要处理没有找到匹配的情况，可以省略默认块。
